description: Search Alibaba.com wholesale products or suppliers, or fetch full product and supplier profiles. Every run is cookieless.

keyword.description: Product or supplier keyword, e.g. 'LED lights' or 'solar panel'. Used by both search modes.
keyword.title: Search keyword

maxItems.description: Maximum number of product or supplier records to save.
maxItems.title: Max records

maxPages.description: Safety limit on result pages (about 40 offers per page). Increase it when filtering heavily or requesting many records.
maxPages.title: Max search pages

maxPrice.description: Drop offers whose lowest listed unit price is above this value.
maxPrice.title: Maximum unit price (USD)

minPrice.description: Drop offers whose lowest listed unit price is below this value.
minPrice.title: Minimum unit price (USD)

minSupplierRating.description: Keep suppliers rated at or above this score out of 5.
minSupplierRating.title: Minimum supplier rating

minSupplierYears.description: Keep suppliers who have been on Alibaba.com at least this many years.
minSupplierYears.title: Minimum supplier tenure (years)

mode.description: Search products, search suppliers, or fetch specific product/supplier pages.
enumTitles: Fetch product details by URL or ID
Fetch supplier profiles by URL or ID
mode.title: Mode

sortBy.description: Sort the collected records before the max-items cut-off.
sortBy.title: Sort results by

startUrls.description: Used by the two detail modes. Paste Alibaba.com product URLs or numeric product IDs, or supplier minisite URLs or supplier IDs. For supplier profile URLs you can also use https://<supplier>.en.alibaba.com/.
startUrls.title: Product or supplier URLs / IDs

supplierCountry.description: Optional two-letter ISO country code, e.g. CN, IN, PK, US. Leave empty for all countries.
supplierCountry.title: Supplier country

tradeAssuranceOnly.description: Keep only products from suppliers that offer Alibaba Trade Assurance order protection.
tradeAssuranceOnly.title: Trade Assurance only

verifiedSupplierOnly.description: Keep only Gold Suppliers or suppliers assessed by a third-party inspection company.
verifiedSupplierOnly.title: Verified suppliers only

title: Alibaba B2B Scraper Input
